selectionReason: Identity, document access/revisions, customer approval and money integrity first. Defer two native revision authorization cases until server contract exists; never waive them.

definitions.expect: Sign in, renew, relaunch and sign out
definitions.steps: Sign in as TEST owner; verify /users/me matches owner; renew session; relaunch; logout; verify company data no longer loads.

definitions.expect: Expired session recovers without losing acknowledged data
definitions.steps: Expire/revoke the TEST session; retry safely; verify acknowledged data survives and the old account cannot populate a new session.

definitions.expect: Signed-out and suspended users cannot read company data
definitions.steps: Attempt company reads signed out, suspended and as other-company owner; verify server denial and no cached records.

definitions.expect: Find seeded estimate and invoice; reopen after relaunch
definitions.steps: Find TEST estimate and invoice using search; open detail and preview; relaunch and reopen; compare IDs and totals to sandbox DB.

definitions.expect: Empty search and unavailable detail recover
definitions.steps: Search nonexistent text; open unavailable ID; interrupt network and retry; verify useful empty/error states and no stale-company content.

definitions.expect: Other tenant document ID is denied
definitions.steps: Use other-company document ID through UI and direct API; verify denial and no customer/private metadata.

definitions.expect: Line addition/removal, quantity, price, discount, tax, payment-term or schedule changes hold collection until customer reapproval or contractor-recorded off-app approval with reason, client approver and approval date; scope descriptions alone do not require reapproval
definitions.steps: Edit quantity/price/tax/discount/terms/schedule; verify collection hold; record reason/client approver/date for off-app approval; verify attributable history and released hold; description-only edit preserves approval.

definitions.expect: Stale decision rejected; existing invoice updated with history; prior ledger retained; removed work marked Removed from job; older document downloads identify newer version
definitions.steps: Use two stale editor/customer sessions; reject stale decisions; update existing invoice with history; keep payment allocations; mark removed tasks Removed from job; identify superseded PDF downloads.

definitions.expect: Customer cannot approve another document or unpublished revision
definitions.steps: Attempt approval of other-company document and unpublished edits; deny unauthorized employee edits/off-app approval; verify server enforcement.

definitions.expect: Open controlled customer link and decide on shown version
definitions.steps: Open seeded guest link without app install; approve/reject/comment on shown version; refresh owner view and verify durable result and version.

definitions.expect: Expired/revoked link denied with useful recovery
definitions.steps: Revoke/expire guest link, interrupt submit, retry; verify no duplicate decision/comment and useful recovery.

definitions.expect: Customer sees only allow-listed document data
definitions.steps: Inspect guest network DTO and other document IDs; verify notes, provider secrets, private audit and unrelated documents remain inaccessible.

definitions.expect: Sandbox payment settles once; provider, ledger and balance match
definitions.steps: Complete Stripe sandbox checkout from seeded customer document; return/relaunch and refresh server state; compare provider event, payment ledger and balance; verify one settlement.

definitions.expect: Cancel, decline, pending and duplicate events do not show paid
definitions.steps: Cancel/decline checkout; deliver duplicate/out-of-order events; lose response then retry; verify no false paid state or duplicate charge.

definitions.expect: Tampered amount and another customer document denied
definitions.steps: Tamper amount, currency, company/document and schedule IDs; verify server rejects mismatch and no unauthorized reservation/charge.

definitions.expect: Record payment/refund and reconcile dashboard and invoice
definitions.steps: Record TEST manual payment and refund; reload invoice and dashboard; reconcile amounts against authoritative ledger including adjustments.
Repeat requests and reorder provider events; verify each money effect applies once and failed/pending refunds remain distinct.

definitions.expect: Unauthorized employee cannot record or refund money
definitions.steps: Attempt payment record/edit/delete/refund as restricted employee and other-company owner; verify denial with unchanged ledger.
